verses.text: Now e happen for di days of Ahasuerus, dis na di Ahasuerus wey rule from India reach Ethiopia, over 127 provinces,
say for dem days, when King Ahasuerus sit for di throne of im kingdom wey dey Shushan di palace,
for di third year of im rule, e make feast for all im princes and im servants. Di power of Persia and Media, di nobles and di princes of di provinces dey before am.
E show di riches of im glorious kingdom and di honor of im great majesty for plenty days, even 180 days.
When dis days finish, di king make feast for all di people wey dey Shushan di palace, big and small, seven days, for di court of di garden of di king palace.

White cotton curtains and blue hangings dey there, wey dem tie with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. Di couches na gold and silver, for floor of red, white, yellow and black marble.
Dem give dem drink inside gold cups, and no two cups dey same, and royal wine plenty, according to di king kindness.
Di drinking na according to di law, nobody force person, because di king don command all di officers of im house say make dem do as each man like.
Queen Vashti make feast for di women too, for di royal house wey belong to King Ahasuerus.
For di seventh day, when di king heart don happy with wine, e command Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar and Carcas, di seven palace officers wey dey serve before King Ahasuerus,
to bring Queen Vashti before di king with di royal crown, to show di peoples and di princes im beauty, because e fine to look at.
But Queen Vashti refuse to come by di king command through di palace officers. So di king vex well well, and im anger burn inside am.
Den di king talk to di wise men wey sabi di times, because na so di king dey do with all wey sabi law and judgment,
and di ones wey dey next to am na Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena and Memucan, di seven princes of Persia and Media, wey dey see di king face and dey sit first for di kingdom,
“Wetin we go do to Queen Vashti according to law, because e no do wetin King Ahasuerus talk through di palace officers?”
Memucan answer before di king and di princes say, “Queen Vashti no do wrong to di king only, but to all di princes and to all di peoples wey dey all di provinces of King Ahasuerus.

Because dis thing wey di queen do go reach all women, and make dem make dem husbands small for dem eyes, when dem report say, ‘King Ahasuerus command say make dem bring Queen Vashti before am, but e no come.’
Today di princesses of Persia and Media wey don hear wetin di queen do go tell am to all di king princes. So plenty shame and anger go dey.

If e good to di king, make royal command go out from am and make dem write am among di laws of di Persians and di Medes, so dat dem no go change am, say Vashti no go come before King Ahasuerus, and make di king give im royal place to another one wey better pass am.
When di king order wey e go make dem announce through all im kingdom, because e big, all di wives go give honor to dem husbands, both big and small.”
Dis word good to di king and di princes, and di king do according to di word of Memucan,

because e send letters go all di king provinces, to every province according to im own writing and to every people for dem own language, say make every man rule for im own house and talk according to di language of im people.
After dis things, when di anger of King Ahasuerus don cool, e remember Vashti, wetin e do and wetin dem decide against am.
Den di king servants wey dey serve am talk say, “Make dem look for fine young virgins for di king.

Make di king appoint officers for all di provinces of im kingdom to gather all di fine young virgins to Shushan di palace, to di women house, under di care of Hegai, di king palace officer, di keeper of di women, and make dem give dem dem beauty oils.
Make di girl wey please di king be queen instead of Vashti.” Dis thing good to di king, and e do so.
One Jew dey for Shushan di palace, im name na Mordecai, Jair pikin, Shimei pikin, Kish pikin, one Benjamite,
wey dem don carry from Jerusalem with di prisoners wey dem carry with Jeconiah, king of Judah, wey Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, don carry go.
E raise Hadassah, wey be Esther, im uncle daughter, because e no get papa or mama. Di girl fine and beautiful, and when im papa and mama die, Mordecai take am as im own daughter.

So e happen say when dem hear di king command and im order, and when plenty girls gather to Shushan di palace under di care of Hegai, dem take Esther go di king house, under di care of Hegai, di keeper of di women.

Di girl please am and e get kindness from am. E quick give am im beauty oils and im share of food, and di seven girls wey dem choose to give am from di king house. E move am and im girls go di best place for di women house.
Esther no tell anybody im people or im family, because Mordecai don tell am say e no suppose tell.
Every day Mordecai dey waka before di court of di women house to know how Esther dey and wetin go happen to am.

Now when di turn of every girl reach to go meet King Ahasuerus, after dem don do am for am according to di law for di women, 12 months, because na so dem dey finish di days of dem beauty treatment, six months with myrrh oil and six months with sweet smells and di women beauty oils,
den na so di girl go dey go meet di king. Anything wey e want, dem go give am to carry go with am from di women house go di king house.

For evening e go go, and for next day e go return go di second women house, under di care of Shaashgaz, di king palace officer, wey dey keep di concubines. E no go go meet di king again, except di king enjoy am and dem call am by name.

Now when di turn of Esther, Abihail daughter, Mordecai uncle, wey take am as im daughter, reach to go meet di king, e no ask for anything except wetin Hegai, di king palace officer, di keeper of di women, tell am. Esther get favor for di eyes of all wey look am.
So dem take Esther go King Ahasuerus for im royal house for di tenth month, wey be di month Tebeth, for di seventh year of im rule.
Di king love Esther pass all di women, and e get favor and kindness before am more than all di virgins. So e put di royal crown on im head and make am queen instead of Vashti.
Den di king make big feast for all im princes and im servants, even Esther feast. E give di provinces rest from tax and give gifts, according to di king kindness.
When dem gather di virgins together di second time, Mordecai dey sit for di king gate.
Esther never tell im family or im people yet, as Mordecai don command am, because Esther dey do wetin Mordecai talk, like when e dey grow with am.
For dem days, as Mordecai dey sit for di king gate, two of di king palace officers, Bigthan and Teresh, wey be doorkeepers, vex and dey look way to lay hands on King Ahasuerus.
Mordecai know di thing, and e tell Queen Esther, and Esther tell di king for Mordecai name.
When dem look into di matter and find say e true, dem hang dem two for tree, and dem write am for di book of di history for di king presence.
After dis things, King Ahasuerus promote Haman, Hammedatha pikin, di Agagite, and raise am high, and put im seat above all di princes wey dey with am.
All di king servants wey dey di king gate bow down and give honor to Haman, because di king don command so about am. But Mordecai no bow down and no give am honor.
Den di king servants wey dey di king gate talk to Mordecai say, “Why you dey disobey di king command?”
Now e happen say as dem dey talk to am every day and e no listen to dem, dem tell Haman to see if Mordecai words go stand, because e don tell dem say e be Jew.
When Haman see say Mordecai no bow down and no give am honor, Haman full with anger.

But e think say e no good to lay hand on Mordecai alone, because dem don tell am about Mordecai people. So Haman look way to destroy all di Jews wey dey all di kingdom of Ahasuerus, even Mordecai people.

For di first month, wey be di month Nisan, for di 12th year of King Ahasuerus, dem cast Pur, wey be di lot, before Haman from day to day and from month to month, reach di 12th month, wey be di month Adar.

Haman talk to King Ahasuerus say, “One people dey wey scatter and spread among di peoples for all di provinces of your kingdom. Dem laws different from di laws of every people, and dem no dey keep di king laws. So e no good for di king to allow dem remain.
If e good to di king, make dem write say make dem destroy dem. I go pay 10,000 talents of silver into di hands of dem wey dey handle di king business, to bring am enter di king treasuries.”
Di king remove im ring from im hand and give am to Haman, Hammedatha pikin, di Agagite, di Jews enemy.
Di king talk to Haman say, “Dem don give you di silver, di people too, to do to dem as e good for you.”

Den dem call di king secretaries for di first month, for di 13th day of di month, and dem write according to all wey Haman command to di king governors, to di rulers wey dey over every province and to di princes of every people, to every province according to im own writing and to every people for dem own language. Dem write am for King Ahasuerus name and seal am with di king ring.

Dem send letters through runners go all di king provinces, to destroy, to kill and to wipe out all di Jews, young and old, small pikin dem and women, for one day, even for di 13th day of di 12th month, wey be di month Adar, and to loot dem property.
Dem make copy of di letter to give out as law for every province, and dem announce am to all di peoples so dat dem go ready for dat day.
Di runners go out quick by di king command, and dem give out di law for Shushan di palace. Di king and Haman sit down to drink, but di city of Shushan dey confuse.
Now when Mordecai know all wey dem don do, Mordecai tear im clothes, wear sackcloth with ashes, and go out inside di city and cry with loud and bitter cry.
E reach before di king gate, because nobody fit enter di king gate wearing sackcloth.
For every province, any place wey di king command and im order reach, big mourning dey among di Jews, with fasting, crying and weeping. Plenty lie down inside sackcloth and ashes.
Esther girls and im palace officers come tell am, and di queen sad well well. E send clothes to Mordecai to wear and to remove im sackcloth, but e no take am.
Den Esther call Hathach, one of di king palace officers wey e don appoint to serve before am, and command am to go meet Mordecai to know wetin dis one be and why.
So Hathach go meet Mordecai for di city square wey dey before di king gate.
Mordecai tell am all wey don happen to am, and di exact money wey Haman don promise to pay into di king treasuries for di Jews, to destroy dem.

E give am di copy of di writing of di law wey dem give out for Shushan to destroy dem, to show Esther and tell am, and to tell am to go meet di king to beg am and to make request before am for im people.
Hathach come tell Esther Mordecai words.
Den Esther talk to Hathach and give am message for Mordecai say,

“All di king servants and di people of di king provinces know say anybody, man or woman, wey go meet di king for di inner court wey dem no call, one law dey for am, say dem go kill am, except di one wey di king stretch di gold scepter to, so dat e go live. But dem no call me to come meet di king for dis 30 days.”
Dem tell Mordecai Esther words.
Den Mordecai ask dem to send answer back to Esther say, “No think for your mind say you go escape for di king house pass all di Jews.
Because if you keep quiet for dis time, help and rescue go rise for di Jews from another place, but you and your papa house go die. Who know if no be for time like dis you come reach di kingdom?”
Den Esther ask dem to send answer back to Mordecai say,

“Go gather all di Jews wey dey Shushan and fast for me. No eat and no drink for three days, night or day. Me and my girls go fast like dat too. Den I go go meet di king, wey no dey according to di law, and if I die, I die.”
So Mordecai go im way and do according to all wey Esther command am.

Now e happen for di third day say Esther wear im royal clothes and stand for di inner court of di king house, opposite di king house. Di king sit for im royal throne for di royal house, opposite di entrance of di house.

E happen say when di king see Esther di queen dey stand for di court, e get favor before am, and di king stretch di gold scepter wey dey im hand to Esther. So Esther come near and touch di top of di scepter.
Den di king talk to am say, “Wetin you want, Queen Esther? Wetin be your request? Dem go give am to you, even reach half of di kingdom.”
Esther talk say, “If e good to di king, make di king and Haman come today to di banquet wey I don prepare for am.”
Den di king talk say, “Bring Haman quick, so dat dem go do as Esther don talk.” So di king and Haman come to di banquet wey Esther don prepare.
Di king talk to Esther for di wine banquet say, “Wetin be your petition? Dem go give am to you. And wetin be your request? Even reach half of di kingdom, dem go do am.”
Den Esther answer say, “Dis na my petition and my request.

If I don find favor before di king, and if e good to di king to grant my petition and do my request, make di king and Haman come to di banquet wey I go prepare for dem, and tomorrow I go do as di king don talk.”
Den Haman go out dat day happy and glad for heart. But when Haman see Mordecai for di king gate, say e no stand up and no move for am, e full with anger against Mordecai.
Still, Haman hold imself and go home. E send and call im friends and Zeresh im wife.
Haman tell dem di glory of im riches, di plenty of im pikin dem, all di things wey di king promote am for, and how e raise am above di princes and servants of di king.
Haman talk say, “Yes, Queen Esther no let anybody come with di king to di banquet wey e prepare except me, and tomorrow e don invite me again together with di king.
Yet all dis no mean anything to me as long as I dey see Mordecai di Jew dey sit for di king gate.”

Den Zeresh im wife and all im friends talk to am say, “Make dem make gallows 50 cubits high, and for morning talk to di king make dem hang Mordecai on am. Den go with di king to di banquet with joy.” Di thing good to Haman, and e make dem make di gallows.
For dat night di king no fit sleep, and e command say make dem bring di book of records of di history, and dem read am before di king.
Dem find write say Mordecai don tell about Bigthana and Teresh, two of di king palace officers wey dey keep di door, wey look way to lay hands on King Ahasuerus.
Di king talk say, “Wetin honor and dignity dem give Mordecai for dis?” Den di king servants wey dey serve am talk say, “Dem no do anything for am.”
Di king talk say, “Who dey di court?” Now Haman don come enter di outer court of di king house, to talk to di king about hanging Mordecai for di gallows wey e don prepare for am.
Di king servants talk to am say, “Look, Haman dey stand for di court.” Di king talk say, “Make e come in.”
So Haman come in. Di king talk to am say, “Wetin dem go do to di man wey di king wan honor?” Now Haman talk for im heart say, “Who di king go wan honor pass me?”
Haman talk to di king say, “For di man wey di king wan honor,
make dem bring royal clothes wey di king dey wear and di horse wey di king dey ride, wey dem put royal crown on im head,

and make dem give di clothes and di horse into di hand of one of di king most noble princes, so dat dem go dress di man wey di king wan honor with dem, and carry am ride on di horse through di city square and announce before am say, ‘Na so dem go do to di man wey di king wan honor.’”
Den di king talk to Haman say, “Hurry and take di clothes and di horse, as you don talk, and do so to Mordecai di Jew, wey dey sit for di king gate. No make anything fail of all wey you don talk.”
Den Haman take di clothes and di horse, dress Mordecai and carry am ride through di city square, and announce before am say, “Na so dem go do to di man wey di king wan honor.”
Mordecai return to di king gate. But Haman hurry go im house, dey mourn with im head covered.

Haman tell Zeresh im wife and all im friends everything wey happen to am. Den im wise men and Zeresh im wife talk to am say, “If Mordecai, wey you don begin to fall before, na from Jews family, you no go win am, but you go surely fall before am.”
As dem still dey talk with am, di king palace officers come near and hurry to carry Haman go di banquet wey Esther don prepare.
So di king and Haman come to banquet with Queen Esther.

Di king talk to Esther again for di second day for di wine banquet say, “Wetin be your petition, Queen Esther? Dem go give am to you. And wetin be your request? Even reach half of di kingdom, dem go do am.”
Den Queen Esther answer say, “If I don find favor before you, O king, and if e good to di king, make dem give me my life as my petition and my people as my request,

because dem don sell us, me and my people, to destroy us, to kill us and to wipe us out. But if dem sell us as male and female slaves, I for keep quiet, even though di enemy no fit pay back di king loss.”
Den King Ahasuerus talk to Queen Esther say, “Who be dis one, and where e dey, wey dare for im heart to do so?”
Esther talk say, “Di enemy and di one wey hate us na dis wicked Haman.” Den Haman fear before di king and di queen.
Di king stand up with anger from di wine banquet and go inside di palace garden. Haman stand up to beg Queen Esther for im life, because e see say di king don decide evil against am.

Den di king return from di palace garden go di place of di wine banquet, and Haman don fall for di couch where Esther dey. Den di king talk say, “E go even attack di queen before me inside di house?” As di word leave di king mouth, dem cover Haman face.

Den Harbonah, one of di palace officers wey dey before di king, talk say, “Look, di gallows 50 cubits high wey Haman don make for Mordecai, wey talk good for di king, dey stand for Haman house.” Di king talk say, “Hang am for am.”
So dem hang Haman for di gallows wey e don prepare for Mordecai. Den di king anger cool.
For dat day King Ahasuerus give Haman house, di Jews enemy, to Queen Esther. Mordecai come before di king, because Esther don tell wetin e be to am.
Di king remove im ring wey e take from Haman and give am to Mordecai. Esther put Mordecai over Haman house.
Esther talk again before di king and fall down for im feet and beg am with tears to remove di wickedness of Haman di Agagite and im plan wey e plan against di Jews.
Den di king stretch di gold scepter to Esther. So Esther stand up and stand before di king.

E talk say, “If e good to di king, and if I don find favor before am, and di thing dey right before di king and I dey please for im eyes, make dem write to cancel di letters wey Haman, Hammedatha pikin, di Agagite, plan and write to destroy di Jews wey dey all di king provinces,
because how I go fit bear to see di evil wey go come on my people? How I go fit bear to see di destruction of my family?”
Den King Ahasuerus talk to Queen Esther and to Mordecai di Jew say, “Look, I don give Esther Haman house, and dem don hang am for di gallows because e lay hand on di Jews.
Write to di Jews too, as e good for una, for di king name and seal am with di king ring, because di writing wey dem write for di king name and seal with di king ring, nobody fit cancel am.”

Den dem call di king secretaries for dat time, for di third month Sivan, for di 23rd day of di month, and dem write according to all wey Mordecai command to di Jews, di governors, di rulers and di princes of di provinces from India reach Ethiopia, 127 provinces, to every province according to im own writing, to every people for dem own language and to di Jews according to dem own writing and dem own language.
E write for King Ahasuerus name and seal am with di king ring, and send letters through runners wey ride horses, wey dey ride royal horses wey dem breed from fast horses,

say di king don allow di Jews wey dey every city to gather together and defend dem life, to destroy, to kill and to wipe out all di power of di people and province wey go attack dem, dem small pikin dem and women, and to loot dem property,
for one day for all di provinces of King Ahasuerus, for di 13th day of di 12th month, wey be di month Adar.
Dem make copy of di letter to give out as law for every province and announce am to all di peoples, so dat di Jews go ready for dat day to take revenge on dem enemies.
So di runners wey ride royal horses go out, dey hurry and dey push by di king command, and dem give out di law for Shushan di palace.
Mordecai go out from di king presence with royal clothes of blue and white, with big gold crown and with robe of fine linen and purple. Di city of Shushan shout and dey glad.
Di Jews get light, gladness, joy and honor.

For every province and every city, any place wey di king command and im order reach, di Jews get gladness and joy, feast and good day. Plenty from among di peoples of di land become Jews, because di fear of di Jews don fall on dem.

Now for di 12th month, wey be di month Adar, for di 13th day of am, when di king command and im order reach di time to do am, for di day wey di enemies of di Jews hope to rule over dem, but e turn to di opposite, so di Jews rule over dem wey hate dem,

di Jews gather together for dem cities through all di provinces of King Ahasuerus to lay hand on dem wey look for dem harm, and nobody fit stand against dem, because di fear of dem don fall on all di peoples.
All di princes of di provinces, di governors, di rulers and dem wey dey do di king business help di Jews, because di fear of Mordecai don fall on dem.
Because Mordecai big for di king house, and im fame go through all di provinces, because Mordecai di man dey grow bigger and bigger.
Di Jews beat all dem enemies with sword, with killing and destruction, and do wetin dem want to dem wey hate dem.
For Shushan di palace di Jews kill and destroy 500 men.
Dem kill Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,
Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,
Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai and Vaizatha,
di ten sons of Haman, Hammedatha pikin, di Jews enemy. Dem kill dem, but dem no lay hand on di loot.
For dat day dem bring di number of dem wey dem kill for Shushan di palace before di king.

Di king talk to Queen Esther say, “Di Jews don kill and destroy 500 men for Shushan di palace and di ten sons of Haman. Wetin dem don do for di rest of di king provinces! Now wetin be your petition? Dem go give am to you. Or wetin be your other request? Dem go do am.”
Den Esther talk say, “If e good to di king, make dem allow di Jews wey dey Shushan to do tomorrow too according to today law, and make dem hang Haman ten sons for di gallows.”
Di king command say make dem do so, and dem give out law for Shushan, and dem hang Haman ten sons.
Di Jews wey dey Shushan gather together for di 14th day of di month Adar too and kill 300 men for Shushan, but dem no lay hand on di loot.
Di other Jews wey dey di king provinces gather together and defend dem lives and get rest from dem enemies, and kill 75,000 of dem wey hate dem, but dem no lay hand on di loot.
Dis happen for di 13th day of di month Adar, and for di 14th day of am dem rest and make am day of feast and gladness.
But di Jews wey dey Shushan gather together for di 13th day of am and for di 14th day of am, and for di 15th day of am dem rest and make am day of feast and gladness.
So di Jews of di villages, wey dey stay for towns wey no get wall, dey make di 14th day of di month Adar day of gladness and feast, good day and day of sending share to each other.
Mordecai write dis things and send letters to all di Jews wey dey all di provinces of King Ahasuerus, near and far,
to command dem to keep di 14th day of di month Adar and di 15th day of am every year,

as di days wey di Jews get rest from dem enemies, and di month wey turn for dem from sorrow to gladness and from mourning to good day, so dat dem go make dem days of feast and gladness, of sending share to each other and gifts to di poor.
Di Jews accept wetin dem don begin to do and wetin Mordecai don write to dem,
because Haman, Hammedatha pikin, di Agagite, di Jews enemy, don plan against di Jews to destroy dem and don cast Pur, wey be di lot, to finish dem and to destroy dem,
but when e reach di king, e command by letters say make im wicked plan wey e plan against di Jews return on im own head, and say make dem hang am and im sons for di gallows.
So dem call dis days Purim, after di name Pur. So because of all di words of dis letter and wetin dem don see about dis matter and wetin don happen to dem,

di Jews make rule and put am on dem self, on dem family and on all wey join dem, so dat e no go fail, say dem go keep dis two days according to wetin dem write and according to di set time every year,

and say dem go remember and keep dis days through every generation, every family, every province and every city, and say dis days of Purim no go fail among di Jews and dem memory no go finish from dem family.
Den Queen Esther, Abihail daughter, and Mordecai di Jew write with all authority to confirm dis second letter of Purim.
E send letters to all di Jews, to di 127 provinces of di kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,
to confirm dis days of Purim for dem set times, as Mordecai di Jew and Queen Esther don decide for dem, and as dem don decide for dem self and for dem family, di matter of di fasting and dem cry.
Esther command confirm dis matters of Purim, and dem write am for di book.
King Ahasuerus put tax on di land and on di islands of di sea.
All di acts of im power and im might, and di full story of di greatness of Mordecai, wey di king raise am to, no be dem write am for di book of di history of di kings of Media and Persia?
Because Mordecai di Jew dey next to King Ahasuerus and e big among di Jews, and di multitude of im brothers accept am. E dey look for di good of im people and dey talk peace to all im family.
